title: Carter asks CIA director George H.W. Bush for UFO briefing and is refused

tellings.quote: he sent for the head of the Central Intelligence Agency to come down to Plains Georgia uh even before he had gone to Washington

plain: After winning the 1976 election, and before he had even gone to Washington, Jimmy Carter is said to have sent for the head of the CIA, then George H. W. Bush, to come down to Plains, Georgia, and to have asked for a briefing on UFOs, which he was refused. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells this on the show as an account passed on to him. If true, an incoming president was denied what the CIA knew about UFOs.
